property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: 3x block replication — tolerates two simultaneous DataNode failures.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: 128 MB DFS block size: large sequential blocks amortise NameNode metadata.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: On-disk location of the NameNode fsimage and edit log.

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Comma-separated DataNode volume list (one entry per physical disk).

property.name: dfs.namenode.handler.count
property.description: Concurrent RPC handler threads on the NameNode (large clusters).

property.name: dfs.blocksize.balancer.bandwidthPerSec
property.description: 100 MB/s cap for the HDFS balancer to avoid saturating the network.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Enable WebHDFS REST API for programmatic file access.
